mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past three months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past three months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.5% in a three-month window, it signals an economic slowdown that triggers a flight to safety, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.5), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of manufacturing supply chain disruption (INDPRO below 100), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to inflationary pressures and reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past three months signals strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where HOUST has increased over the past three months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers a hawkish monetary policy response, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a deteriorating labor market, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of slowing GDP growth (GDPC1 growth rate below 1.0% annualized), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where GDPC1 growth rate < 1.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
